combat.accuracy: 0.55 + (skill + gear accuracy - monster def x tier mult) x 0.01, clamp 0.15..0.95, x1.15 on weakness
combat.maxHit: floor(0.35 skill + 0.6 gear strength + 2) - floor(0.03 monster def), x1.2 on weakness; blow = uniform 1..maxHit; Level adds nothing to damage
combat.monsterHit: acc 0.5 + (atk - (Defense + shield/cape def)) x 0.02 clamp 0.05..0.85; maxHit atk x {"base":5.4,"byTier":{"3":4,"4":4,"5":3,"6":2.2}}

party.xpSplit: kill XP / living heroes x each hero's multiplier (xp-share.js; no party bonus)
party.gold: coin split evenly among heroes present, commons round-robin, rares by the 1-100 roll with rotation (party-split.js); store supplies paid by each hero (one purse per account)

pace.reference: median of 8 solo styles, Level 1 to 50, where the Hunts window recommends, as built (tools/balance-sim plan pace)

curve.reference: BOUND, not the pace of record: median style, best safe solo cell per Level on a ground whose floor it has reached, either density, measured to L55, then xp/h = 4608.5 x L^0.944 (extrapolated: no ground past L55)

proposedGuard.cells: the 12 reference cells of plan whatif at x=W0 (every ground, solo + a four, as built + the full box, in band + under a floor), 3 h x 2 seeds
proposedGuard.runsOn: a diff touching src/data/{monsters,hunt-grounds,hunts,items,gear-tiers,shields,supply-basics,core-model,hunt-roles,rule-subjects}.js or src/core/** (mutant-gate style), nightly otherwise
proposedGuard.costS: about 45 s on 4 workers, about 3 min single-process on a CI runner

tolerances.deathsInBandNormal: 0 in the cell's 6 h (at the ruling's <= 1 per 1,000 h a false alarm is < 1%)
tolerances.bandLabel: the difficulty band must not change

proposedGuard.baseline: tools/balance-sim/baseline-summary.json (re-written by report.mjs; a deliberate balance change re-pins it in the same commit, like ci-shape --write)
